sources.title: Dental Implant Social Media Content
usedFor: 40 paid angles across video, static, and carousel

stages.action: Choose one ready unit from ads.json or organic-calendar.json. Skip needs-consent units until a signed social-media release exists.

Read formats in design-system.json. Video is 1080x1920 with a 2.5 second video-end-card. Static is one 1080x1350 frame plus a 1080x1080 square, with no voiceover. Carousel is 1080x1350 slides and the last slide is cta-still. Paint only with token names. Run buildPromptPrefix() for any generated frame.
Run the social pipeline test. No prices, no guarantee, no Dr. Szarski, no invented patient, no unsourced percentage, no fake scarcity.

Read skills.use entries whose when matches this stage and the unit format. The frame is Renew Implant Centre: design-system.json tokens, DM Serif Display, Plus Jakarta Sans, and the typed renew implants wordmark. Make the unit in its format. Video is filmed or generated with the spoken line. Static is one still. Carousel is the slide list, in order. Clinic stills use approvedMedia only. Generated people are allowed for the denture-slip video and must look lived-in, with no extra facial or hand features and no blood or needles.

Video only: hold video-end-card for 2.5 seconds. Static and carousel already end on the design system, and carousel must close on cta-still. Wordmark, one serif line, lime pill, phone as secondary text.
Primary click goes to the unit ctaHref (the implant quiz). The phone number may be spoken or set in caption text. Cross-posting follows distribution.json.

cadence.organic: Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday. The 30 feed posts are 10 video, 10 static, and 10 carousel. Stories are 3 to 5 short clips a week and are not a substitute for that mix.
cadence.paid: 41 units: 14 video, 14 static, and 13 carousel. Launch one angle at a time. Do not launch a unit until the copy in ads.json is the copy on the screen.
cadence.batch: Film the video units in one sitting, then design the static frames and carousels from the same visit. Change scrubs between setups so the weeks do not look identical.

primaryCta.labelRule: About two minutes and nine questions. Never promise a faster quiz.

use.take: The catalog, the design tokens, the wordmark, and the clinic claim rules win over every other skill.
use.ignore: Nothing in this skill is optional.

use.take: Do not paint pixels until the unit and design-system.json are the brief.
use.ignore: The org handoff files, verifier ritual, and business-idea paths. This clinic's brief is docs/content/social/.

use.take: Instagram and Facebook carousels are 1080x1350. One idea per slide. The last slide is the CTA.
use.ignore: The belt CLI, the 7-slide hook template, LinkedIn and X sizes, and any example that uses a statistic or a generic font.

use.take: Instagram and Facebook video is 1080x1920, short, with sound and a safe margin.
use.ignore: Seedance scene generation, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and any new hook.

use.when: make, format video or a square crop of a static
use.take: Assemble the clip, hold the end card, and export the file.
use.ignore: Do not reframe the picture into a different aspect than the unit canvas.

use.when: make, when the end card or a type slide is rendered in code
use.take: Render the branded type frames as video rather than filming a slide.
use.ignore: Layouts other than the ones in design-system.json.

use.take: Prompt in prose, name the hex from buildPromptPrefix(), and describe the skin and light you want.
use.ignore: Do not generate a frame for a unit whose assetRefs already point at approvedMedia. Do not use a negative prompt.

use.take: Camera, lens, and light in the prompt. One job per image. Positive wording only. The subject is a Renew clinic still or the generated person named in the unit.
use.ignore: Local model routing, and any still that is typeset rather than photographed.

use.when: make, generated stills only, after the Renew prompt prefix
use.take: How to phrase a still prompt once the palette and wordmark are already locked.
use.ignore: Model picks that replace the design system, and any prompt written before buildPromptPrefix().

use.take: How a finished Meta ad is placed. The unit copy is already written.
use.ignore: New headlines, new offers, budgets, and audiences that are not in the unit.

brand.name: Renew Implant Centre
brand.rule: Every frame is Renew Implant Centre. A skill may supply a technique. The colors, type, and wordmark come from design-system.json.
